text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spring of the Senior Class.
To aim for even greater heights, she crossed the sea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Heading toward the golden city shining brilliantly in the desert—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: This is Dubai...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: It's wonderful, there are so many beautiful buildings...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It really is moving, right?!
If you're curious about anything, just ask away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To participate in an event race,
I traveled to Dubai
with Red Desire and Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A festival race held to bring excitement to the global racing world.
Top Umamusume from across the globe, renowned for both skill and popularity, gather here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This is the story of how she came to run in the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: First, learning that Vodka, who had experience racing in Dubai, was brought up as a candidate—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurried to negotiate and see
if there was any way Red Desire could participate as well.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Your enthusiasm came through loud and clear.
Your abilities are beyond question, and gaining overseas experience
before a major race is of utmost importance.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Very well. Take Red Desire with you,
and make sure you bring home a victory in Dubai!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A glamorous event race held at Dubai's
premier racecourse, bringing together
racing fans from all over the world—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's the absolute best stage for Red Desire's
first step toward taking on the world!

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look! It's Vodka!
Wow, she's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text:
No kidding.
She farms aura!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm the coolest girl around, Vodka!
I'm gonna rock the world this year too! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tourists
text_block_list.text: Badass!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!? Vodka-san, are you drawing attention here too...!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "And communicating in English on top of that...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh, looks like word's totally gotten around about how cool I am, huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't understand English,
but through the vibe, it hit me loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: That sheer decisiveness... and that overwhelming presence...!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san, you are...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even across the sea, it remains unchanged—
you still captivate everyone so deeply...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Aren't we checking out the town?
Hurry up!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah, please wait, Vodka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Although Red Desire had little overseas experience, she showed no signs of travel fatigue or distress from being in an unfamiliar land, remaining completely relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With this, it looks like they'll be able to perform at their full potential.
choice_data_list: (It's finally time to test your skills against the world, Desire!)
(It's finally time to test your skills against the world, Desire!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After taking a look around the town,
we headed toward the racetrack—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhh...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The state of the mana swirling across this racecourse...
It truly is quite different from that of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“—However, the fire in my chest
before a race never changes.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to seize it.
Here, too, I shall grasp that grand brilliance—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. No matter where in the world I go,
there's only one thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tread firmly upon the ground, run faster than anyone else,
and stay ahead of everyone else. —That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do this, Desire!
Let's show the world that the coolest Umamusume
ever came straight from Japan!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with this run,
I shall make my declaration.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That from here on, their battle
to conquer the world would begin—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire's challenge to the world—
has now begun!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (The sensation of each step is completely different...!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(So this is what it means to run on the world stage...
This is our brand-new challenge...!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I can do this!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahーー!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire closes in from the back,
charging with blazing speed as if to swallow everything whole!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah...
choice_data_list: Desire! You got first place! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Trainer...!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I did it...!
I really did it... even in an overseas race!!
choice_data_list: Yeah! You can race overseas too... absolutely!
Yeah! You can make it overseas too... absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire made a bold, sweeping move from the far outside,
putting on a display of phenomenal late-race speed and tremendous grit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the other hand...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Vodka, who had been running near the front, lost momentum in the final stretch... finishing in 8th place.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...
Why... Why did it...—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ――...I can still do this, can't I?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Desire, you're freaking amazing.
That was seriously incredible!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Vodka...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Gaaah!
I wanted to win so baaaad!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Next! I'll get my payback next time,
so you better be ready, Desire!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes! Absolutely...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Red Desire's challenge in Dubai ended in great success—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"It has a completely different charm at night, doesn't it...?
Dazzling and sparkling... Truly magnificent..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"When might I visit next?
When will I be able to run with Vodka-san again, I wonder...?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It'll be in no time!
Besides, I wanna run with you right now, too!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: W-Well then! Let's do this again, maybe tomorrow—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I've known for a while that you've got what it takes, and that's why I invited you to go overseas with me.
...Today, I'm completely sure of it."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I don't give it everything, I'll be completely swallowed up.
You really are a rival meant to compete on the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And also... someone who can chase
sights no one's ever seen before with me!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Such gracious words,
are you truly certain it is all right...?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna keep running toward that "Otherworld" thing
from now on too, right?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
For that is my destiny.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...And then—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Competing with Buena-san and standing alongside Vodka-san... I can sense it now."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Just like today... no, only beyond overwhelming the world with power far greater than this!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The door to the 'Otherworld' that I have
truly sought will finally be opened—!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're really something else.
I knew I was right to believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Outcasts like us, you see,
can't be satisfied with the ordinary. It's a bottomless swamp.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, there's a world out there only people like that can unlock.
—A place even more dazzling than this night view!”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Desire, let's do this!
We'll smash the status quo and seize
the glory no one else could ever achieve!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Standing shoulder-to-shoulder with you,
I shall burn this soul, this desire, to absolute cinders.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"That is the new destiny
bestowed upon me!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what I'm talking about!
Let's see which of us devours the world first, me or you!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Our true battle must take place on a grand, glamorous stage filled with hope. Yes...—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The prestigious, world-class pinnacle race, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
Or... the Breeders' Cup, a festival of dreams
brimming with grand romance.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Whichever trial it may be,
I shall surely overcome it—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A new ambition sworn under the Dubai night sky—they had now taken a powerful step toward uncharted territory.
